title: UI round 3 · S4: the opened task and task page (one state line, plain words, ruling first, Change drawer)
description:
Slice 4 of 5 of LIN-4040 (UI round 3: Home and the run control). Feedback items 15, 16, 19 and 20. Lands after slice 3 (Home as a desk).

## This piece's slice of the approved plan (D7, all but type)

**Files:** `lib/render-task-page.js`, `public/task-page.js`, the opened-box render in `lib/render.js` / `public/prompt-section.js` (surface `home` and `task`), `lib/question-card.js` (the Change drawer and the ruling options), and `llms.txt` if the DOM changes.

**Approach:**

* Every opened task and the task page get **one pill and one sentence** for their state. No "Tracker:" / "Harbour:" pair. The words come from the server's decision (LIN-4071: `deriveHeader` only writes the sentence), so no rule moves into the browser.
* Use plain words instead of machine words, for example "Last run: Close-out finished 10 minutes ago · all 13 runs".
* The Change drawer gets room: a heading, the default shown as a readable choice, its numbers, and links to the house pages.
* The task page puts the question (the ruling card) **before** "Runs on" and "Another step".

## Testing (witnesses)

* The task page has one state-line element and no "Tracker:".
* On the task page, the question card comes before the run block in the DOM.
* A unit test covers the last-run words: finished, failed and running, with and without a count.
* Screenshots of the opened box and the task page for a waiting task, a running task, a failed task and a never-run task.

Session fit: fits one session

**Grounding commit:** `27ae64ad` (LinearViewer `origin/main`, the sha the plan was written and reviewed against; still HEAD at breakdown, 1 Nov 20:45Z).

**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4040's approving plan-review (comment `b12f09b0-f5e1-4782-aab9-c38065fbf173`, rev 1 of the fresh 1 Nov plan).

## Implemented (close-out, 2026-11-03)

Implemented as approved in LIN-4040's plan, with the deviations noted on LIN-4040 (comment 4cd757ab) and in the review: the Change drawer lives in `public/prompt-section.js` (not `lib/question-card.js`) and the file is `public/llms.txt`. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254>), squash commit `300c811f`, live on [harbour.cat](<http://harbour.cat>). Outside follow-up: LIN-4159 (Home "needs you" vs task page "waiting"). The full pre-prune description is preserved in the task snapshots, and the full history in the comment trail.

## LIN-4106 beat 1: E2E baseline at base `015aa4c6` (before any change)

`npx playwright test` (full suite, 1,978 tests): 1,974 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped.

Failures, and what a rerun showed (isolated, same base):
- `live-console.spec.js:444` route A: `.lc-pulse` geometry and `.lc-page` max-width (LIN-1741). Fails on rerun. Pre-existing at base, outside this slice.

## LIN-4106 beat 2 done: task page state line and ruling card first

**Changed:** `lib/render-task-page.js` (no "Tracker:" line, no "Harbour:" label, ruling card before the run control), `lib/task-page-loader.js` (idle sentence now "Last run: <stage> finished|failed|was cancelled <when> · all N runs" or "· the only run"), new `tests/unit/lin-4106-task-page-state-line.test.js` (11 tests), golden fixture regenerated (label, tracker line, settling sentence and question order only), `public/llms.txt`, `docs/architecture/ui-pieces.md`, styleguide text.

**Failing then passing:** on the unchanged `lib` code 8 of the 11 new tests fail; the 3 that pass are regression pins.

**Pre-existing tests updated to the new contract:** `lin-3975-task-run-control`, `lin-3975-styleguide`, `task-page-loader`, `lin-3968-next-step`, `lin-3991-failed-pill`, e2e `task-page.spec.js` idle sentence.

**Results:** unit 22,539 pass / 0 fail (baseline 22,528 + 11 new). E2E across 37 task-page-related specs: 435 pass, 1 fail, which is the pre-existing `live-console` geometry pin that also fails at base `015aa4c6`.

**Grep record:** all three greps from the plan's "Where the behaviour lives" are on this ticket (grep 1 and 3 in the start-of-work comment, grep 2 in the two follow-up comments). The plan names exactly three (LIN-4040 lines 118-120).

## LIN-4106 beat 3 done: opened box on Home is the task page's state line; drawer heading and house links

Commit `e4d65b34` on `feat/lin-4106-opened-task-state-line` (pushed, no PR yet).

**Changed:** `lib/render-task-page.js` (Home's line draws the server's sentence, no "No session running."), `public/prompt-section.js` (raw "Last:" clause removed, the All-runs button kept; drawer heading `run-change-heading`; Dispatch link `run-dispatch-link`), `public/style.css` (heading rule), `public/llms.txt`, tests: new `tests/unit/lin-4106-home-state-line.test.js`, drawer and Last-line tests appended to `lin-3833-run-control`, `lin-4010` idle-line assertion rewritten.

**Failing then passing:** with the implementation stashed, 7 of the new or rewritten tests fail; 85 pass as regression pins.

**E2E:** the phone first-screen test (`lin-3987-decision-panel`, Use inside 844px) regressed from the heading and is fixed (11 of 11 pass). Two `lin-3975-task-run` timing flakes passed alone (9 of 9); `live-console` geometry fails on base too.

**Unit:** 22,551 pass, 0 fail (baseline 22,539 plus 12 new).

Drift & Coherence Review 2026-11-03 (LIN-4153, report PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2253). Delta comment, not a body edit.

Merge-ready task state is still decided outside the owner: `render-task-page.js:108` (`READY_TASK_STATE` needs-you), repainted to waiting by `public/task-page.js:507-508,721`. `deriveHeader` precedence still differs from `pageStatusOf`.

## LIN-4106: final summary (beat 4)

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254 (not merged)
**Commit:** 850b5353 on feat/lin-4106-opened-task-state-line (branch from main 015aa4c6)

**What it does:** the opened task and the task page draw one state line (one pill, one plain-words sentence from the server's decision, e.g. "Last run: Plan finished 10 minutes ago · the only run"). The "Tracker:" line and "Harbour:" label are gone. The ruling card comes before "Runs on" and "Another step", in the DOM and on desktop (the grid rows were swapped in public/task-page.css). The Change drawer has a heading, the default choice in words with the step's runs and typical run, and house links to Settings › Models and Dispatch ›.

**CI (run 41597514555, all on PR #2254):** CI success pass; Unit tests pass (8m19s); E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4 pass; Secret scan pass.

**Local tests:**
- Unit: 22,553 pass, 0 fail (baseline 22,528 / 0; +25 new tests).
- Full Playwright, 1,983 total: 1,979 pass, 3 fail, 1 skipped (base: 1,974 / 3 / 1).
  - live-console.spec.js:444: fails on base too (pre-existing).
  - look-alike-controls.spec.js:209: the known flake. Passes when rerun alone.
  - ship-biscuit.spec.js:118: new to the list in this run, not on base. Passes when rerun alone; under 4-worker load its visibility wait times out. Not related to this change.
  - swipe.spec.js:477 (on base): passes in this run.
- New E2E spec (tests/e2e/lin-4106-task-page-state-line.spec.js): 5 tests pass on the branch. Against origin/main, 4 fail (old wording, ruling card after the run block, no drawer heading). The phone first-screen test passes on both.

**Greps (plan's three), start vs end:** 117 / 315 / 17 before and after. Nothing removed here: the estimate removal landed in LIN-4103 and LIN-4104. Remaining hits are classified in the start-of-work comments.

**Screenshots:** docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-03-lin4106/ (22 PNGs, 1280px and 390px, light and dark; owner with a runner, and a new user with no runner). Made by tests/visual/lin-4106-screenshots.spec.js.

**Deviations from LIN-4040's plan:** noted on LIN-4040 (comment 4cd757ab).

**Open for the team:** Home says "needs you" where the task page says "waiting" for the same state. Product wording, not changed here.

## Review — LIN-4106

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254 at head `850b5353` (4 commits on base `015aa4c6`; `origin/main` has since moved to `aeefaf6a`, a docs-only drift report, and the PR is still MERGEABLE).

CI: green on `850b5353`: CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4 and Secret scan all pass (run 41597514555).

### Scope against the plan
- The files match the ticket, with two corrections the implementation already recorded: the Change drawer is in `public/prompt-section.js`, not `lib/question-card.js`, and `llms.txt` is at `public/llms.txt`. `public/task-page.js` needed no code change. Its poll repaints only `task-page-answer-status`, and a question card that appears later still reloads the page, so the new order holds.
- Each requirement is met in code: one pill and one sentence, with no `Tracker:` line or `Harbour:` label (the tracker's word is now in `task-page-detail-state`); "Last run: <Stage> finished|failed|was cancelled <when> · all N runs / the only run" from `idleRung` on the server; the ruling card before the run control in the DOM and in both desktop grid templates; and the drawer heading, the default card and the house links (Settings › Models, Dispatch ›). No rule moved into the browser: `renderHomeStatus` and `renderTaskStatus` draw `model.sentence` as the server sent it.

### Mutation checks (each one reverted afterwards)
Each mutation turned its tests red:
- M1: put `${owner.question}` back after the run control. Fails: "a waiting task: the question sits before the run control".
- M2: `runCountClause` returns `''`. 4 last-run tests fail.
- M3: Home draws "No session running." again. 3 tests in lin-4106-home fail.
- M4: put a `task-page-tracker-state` "Tracker:" line back. Fails in both lin-3975 and lin-4106.
- M5: drop the drawer heading. M6: drop the `run-dispatch-link` testid. M7: `'was cancelled'` becomes `'cancelled'`. Each fails its own test.
- M8 (E2E): swap `"question question"`/`"run run"` back in `public/task-page.css`. When only the first template (the one with a brief beside the stages) is swapped, the E2E spec stays green, because its fixture uses the `--quiet-context` grid. When both are swapped it fails ("the ruling card is drawn above "Runs on""). So the grid with a brief has no witness (ledger item 5).
- The new E2E spec passes 5 of 5 locally on `850b5353`.

### Regression check
`git log -S wordOnly` on `lib/render-task-page.js` traces the removed `wordOnly` branch to `27ae64ad` (LIN-4071: "a finished or backlog task shows its word, as its row does"). For `done`, removing it is intended: the ticket asks for one pill and one sentence, and the new test pins "Finished …". For `backlog` it brings back a sentence LIN-4024 (items 9 and 20) removed from Home. I rendered `renderHomeStatus` at base and at head with the same model:
- base: `backlog` pill, empty sentence
- head: `backlog` pill + **"No sessions yet."**

No test covers backlog, which is why CI stays green (ledger item 1).

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "the old two-label / `No session running. Last:` wording on the opened task and the task page". The renderers are clean. The siblings left are in docs and comments, all **inside** (this ticket's DOM/doc surface; `llms.txt` is named in the ticket's file list):
- `public/llms.txt:64` still describes the task page's "a "Last: … · All N" line that opens the Sessions fold". That line is now only the `opened-task-all` button.
- `lib/task-page-loader.js:687` (the `deriveHeader` JSDoc) still says `"No session running. Last: <stage> <end> <when>."`
- `public/task-page.js:595` ("the tracker line beside it") and `public/prompt-section.js:987` ("Its own idle line ("No session running.")") are stale comments.

### What CI Did Not Prove
1. **Inside** (the state-line class: one plain-words line on Home; this is the cause, `wordOnly` removed in `lib/render-task-page.js`). On Home, a backlog task with no sessions now reads "backlog · No sessions yet.", which LIN-4024 removed. **Before the merge:** in `renderHomeStatus`, draw the sentence as `''` when `state === 'backlog' && !hasSessions`, leaving `done` and backlog-with-runs as they are. Add a unit test in `tests/unit/lin-4106-home-state-line.test.js`: a model with `status: 'backlog'`, `sessions: []`, `sentence: 'No sessions yet.'` and taskState `backlog` must not contain "No sessions yet". It must fail on `850b5353` and pass after the fix.
2. **Inside** (plain words, the same class). With the "Last: …" text removed, the line under Home's run box is a bare **"All 1"** / **"All 13"** button (see `opened-box-owner-dark-390.png`). That fragment only made sense after "Last: … ·". **Before the merge:** change the label in `public/prompt-section.js` `renderLastLine` to plain words, e.g. `All ${n} runs` (or `The only run` when n is 1). Keep `data-testid="opened-task-all"` and `data-action="all-sessions"`. Update the `lin-3833` / `lin-4010` / e2e assertions that match `All N`.
3. **Inside** (llms.txt is in the ticket's file list). Fix the stale docs and comments listed above: `public/llms.txt:64` becomes "and an All-runs button (`opened-task-all`) that opens the Sessions fold"; the `lib/task-page-loader.js:687` JSDoc becomes `"Last run: <Stage> finished|failed|was cancelled <when> · all N runs" / "· the only run" / "No sessions yet."`; and the two comments at `public/task-page.js:595` and `public/prompt-section.js:987`. **Before the merge:** grep for `No session running\. Last|Last: … · All N|tracker line beside` across `lib public` and expect no hits.
4. **Inside** (the ticket's own testing list). The ticket asks for screenshots of a waiting, a running, a failed and a never-run task. `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-03-lin4106/` has waiting and idle/finished (plus the drawer) only, and the new-user opened box is 1280px only. **Before the merge:** add running, failed and never-run cases to `tests/visual/lin-4106-screenshots.spec.js` (owner, 1280 and 390, light and dark) and commit the PNGs. Look at them: the failed one must read "Last run: <Stage> failed <when>: <message> · …" with the `failed` pill, and the never-run one must have no Home line.
5. **Inside** (the ruling card first on desktop). The desktop grid template used when a brief or recap sits beside the stages (`public/task-page.css` first `grid-template-areas`) has no witness: the E2E fixture only reaches the `--quiet-context` template (mutation M8). **Before the merge:** either seed a cached brief in one run of the "ruling card comes before" E2E test, or add a unit or CSS check that both templates list `"question question"` before `"run run"`. Confirm it fails when only the first template is swapped back.
6. **Outside**: Home says "needs you" while the task page says "waiting" for the same merge-ready or waiting state (`render-task-page.js:108` READY_TASK_STATE, repainted at `public/task-page.js:507-508,721`). The implementation flagged it and the LIN-4153 drift review already recorded it. It is product wording and not this slice's class. Close-out should check whether a ticket already exists before filing one.

Rollback: the change is UI-only with no persisted shape, so reverting the PR's merge commit backs it out completely.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. All four requirements are in place, server-owned, and their tests catch the mutations above. Before the merge, close-out must make fixes 1–3 (the backlog line on Home is a small regression from removing `wordOnly`), add the missing state screenshots (4) and the witness for the grid with a brief (5), then re-check CI on the new head.

## LIN-4106: merged, close-out paused at the deploy (not closed)

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254, squash commit `300c811f` on `main`, pinned with `--match-head-commit dba3fbd5` (the commit CI passed on).

### Review's fixes, each made in `dba3fbd5` (pushed to the PR branch before the merge)
1. Ledger 1: `renderHomeStatus` (`lib/render-task-page.js`) draws no sentence for `backlog` with no sessions; the pill stays. New unit tests in `tests/unit/lin-4106-home-state-line.test.js`. The no-sessions test fails with the fix removed and passes with it.
2. Ledger 2: the Home button reads `The only run` / `All N runs` (`public/prompt-section.js` `renderLastLine`); `data-testid="opened-task-all"` and `data-action="all-sessions"` kept. Test in `tests/unit/lin-3833-run-control.test.js`, which fails on the old label. No existing assertion matched `All N`.
3. Ledger 3: stale text fixed in `public/llms.txt:64`, the `lib/task-page-loader.js` `deriveHeader` JSDoc and a second comment there, `public/task-page.js:595`, and two comments in `public/prompt-section.js`. `grep -rnE "No session running\. Last|Last: … · All N|tracker line beside" lib public` now returns nothing.
4. Ledger 4: `tests/visual/lin-4106-screenshots.spec.js` now also makes running, failed and never-run (task page and Home box, owner, 1280/390, light and dark): 24 PNGs in `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-03-lin4106/`. I looked at them: the failed task reads "Last run: Plan failed just now: the build broke · the only run" with the `failed` pill on both surfaces; the never-run Home box has no state line; the running one has none either (the running box says it).
5. Ledger 5: new `tests/unit/lin-4106-task-page-grid-order.test.js` reads both desktop `grid-template-areas` in `public/task-page.css` and asserts `question question` is before `run run` in each. It fails when only the first template is swapped back (checked), which the E2E spec could not catch.

### CI
- On PR head `dba3fbd5` (run 41599762955): CI success, Unit tests, E2E 1/4 to 4/4 and Secret scan all pass; head SHA of the run confirmed equal to the PR head before merging.
- Local: unit suite 22,558 pass / 0 fail; the lin-4106, lin-4010 and lin-3968 E2E specs 22/22.
- On `main` at `300c811f` (run 41600882212): E2E shard 2/4 failed `look-alike-controls.spec.js:209` on all three attempts (a read-only `GET .../dispatch/preview?promptName=autopilot&surface=task` was seen during the look-alike clicks). This is the flake LIN-4110 tracks and my baseline at the base commit recorded; it passes 3/3 in isolation on `300c811f`. I re-ran the failed job and the run is now green (CI success).

### Outside item (ledger 6)
Filed **LIN-4159** (Medium, `Improvement`, related to this ticket): Home says "needs you" where the task page says "waiting". Existing-ticket search (title words, `READY_TASK_STATE`, relations) found no ticket for it. Priority reasoning: wording inconsistency, no data risk, small blast radius.

### Why this is still open
The deploy has not landed. `https://harbour.cat` footer still shows `be838ddd`. The Railway production deployment for `300c811f` went `in_progress` at 08:06:55Z and `inactive` at 08:13:50Z without a `success` status, about when the first `main` run failed on the flake above. The `main` run was green on rerun at about 08:20Z and no new Railway deployment followed. I did not link the Railway CLI or redeploy production: that login is the user's own and was not given for this task.

**Left to do (next action: `implementation`, by someone with Railway access):** redeploy `300c811f` (or later) to Harbour / production, then confirm the footer shows it. After that: verify the opened box and task page on what landed (one pill and one sentence; ruling card before `Runs on`; Change drawer heading; Home backlog task has no "No sessions yet."; "All N runs" label), set LIN-4106 to Done, post the close-out summary, archive and prune this description. LIN-4159 is already filed, so do not file it again.

Rollback: UI-only, no persisted shape; revert merge commit `300c811f`.

## Survey spike 1a (implementation)

**1. Why was it difficult?** It was moderately difficult. The work itself was small, but a few things held it back:

- **One fact was said in three places.** "What the last run did" was written by `deriveHeader`'s `idleRung` on the server. `renderHomeStatus` rewrote it ("No session running.", a word-only line for done tasks). The client's `renderLastLine` said it again with raw state words ("Last: Build done"). One sentence change touched all three, plus their pinned tests: `task-page-loader`, `lin-3968`, `lin-3991`, `lin-4010`, and the golden fixture.
- **"Ruling first" lived in two places.** One was the DOM order in `renderTaskPage`; the other was the desktop `grid-template-areas` in `public/task-page.css`, which drew the run row above the question. DOM-order tests passed while the page drew the card second. Only a screenshot showed it.
- **The phone budget was hidden.** `lin-3987` keeps "Use for this run" inside 844px with almost no headroom. The drawer heading regressed it, which I fixed; adding the spend to the default card broke it again, so I reverted that.
- **Pinned markup.** A regex on `opened-task-change-head">` meant the heading had to be a new sibling rather than a restructure of the head row.
- **A seeding trap.** `create-dispatch-token` registers a runner, so my first "new user, no runner" screenshot had one.

**2. What I'd have done first.** A small tidy: have the server say "the last run" once, and have the task page, Home line and Last line all use it. That would have removed about a third of the test churn and both client rewrites. I'd also have measured the phone headroom first, and added a drawn-order check from the start.

**3. What the ticket and plan got wrong:**

- The Change drawer is in `public/prompt-section.js` (`run-change-panel`), not `lib/question-card.js`.
- `llms.txt` is at `public/llms.txt`, not the root.
- "Ruling first" was framed as DOM order, but the CSS grid decides the drawn order on desktop.
- "Its numbers" didn't say which figures, and nothing mentioned the first-screen limit.
- "Surface `home` and `task`" didn't say what shape it meant.
- Two beat prompts said grep 3 was missing; it had been posted at the start.

Autopilot verb-override note (LIN-4106): the operator answered the redeploy decision (human-redeploy) and I confirmed harbour.cat now serves 300c811f. The engine then recommended kind=blocked, but the blocker was cleared, so I pinned kind=close-out (dispatch 2da737a3) and aborted the stray blocked dispatch (4f7d49c7).

## Close-out — LIN-4106

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2254, squash commit `300c811f`, pinned with `--match-head-commit dba3fbd5` (the commit CI passed on). Review verdict: Approve, conditional on the ledger.

### Changes made after the approval (all in `dba3fbd5`, made in the earlier close-out session)
1. Review ledger 1: `renderHomeStatus` draws no sentence for a backlog task with no sessions (the pill stays). Unit tests added in `tests/unit/lin-4106-home-state-line.test.js`; the no-sessions test fails with the fix removed.
2. Review ledger 2: the Home button reads `The only run` / `All N runs` (`public/prompt-section.js` `renderLastLine`), test ids kept.
3. Review ledger 3: stale docs and comments fixed (`public/llms.txt:64`, `lib/task-page-loader.js`, `public/task-page.js`, `public/prompt-section.js`); the review's grep returns no hits.
4. Review ledger 4: running, failed and never-run screenshots added (24 PNGs in `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-03-lin4106/`).
5. Review ledger 5: `tests/unit/lin-4106-task-page-grid-order.test.js` checks `question question` before `run run` in both desktop grid templates.

### Ledger
- Items 1–5 (inside): done, with the evidence above.
- Item 6 (outside): LIN-4159 (Medium, Improvement, related to this ticket) already exists for Home "needs you" vs task page "waiting". Not re-filed.
- Rollback named by review: revert merge commit `300c811f` (UI-only, no persisted shape).

### CI
PR head `dba3fbd5` (run 41599762955): CI success, Unit, E2E 1/4–4/4 and Secret scan green. `main` at `300c811f` (run 41600882212): green on rerun after the known `look-alike-controls.spec.js:209` flake (tracked as LIN-4110).

### Deploy and live check
The first Railway deployment of `300c811f` never reached success. After the operator redeployed, `https://harbour.cat` was confirmed serving `300c811f` (page footer). Checked on what landed:
- Served `/prompt-section.js` has `The only run` / `All ${n} runs`, the Change drawer (`run-change-panel`) with the Settings › Models note and `run-dispatch-link` (Dispatch ›).
- Served `/task-page.css`: both desktop `grid-template-areas` list `"question question"` before `"run run"`.
- Served `/llms.txt:64` carries the corrected text (`opened-task-all`, "Last run: … · all N runs").

**Not run:** the server-rendered opened box and task page for a real task (one pill + one sentence, no `Tracker:`, ruling card before `Runs on`, no "No sessions yet." on a Home backlog task). Those need a signed-in session, which this runner does not have; the same behaviour was checked by the unit and E2E specs on the merged commit and in the screenshots. Anyone signed in can open a waiting task and a backlog task on harbour.cat to confirm.

### Housekeeping
Description archived (snapshot captured 2026-11-03T11:46:35Z, verified in `/snapshots`) and pruned to a stub, keeping the problem, approach, testing, session-fit and plan-review lines. Siblings: LIN-4107 (S5) is blocked by this ticket and stays Todo; LIN-4159 stays in Backlog.
